text:
Mira: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: recurring eviction + queue-growth pattern. Need owners for short sprint: runbook edits, detection, and fallback policy.
Tony: I'll update the runbook with concise triage steps and a fast rollback snippet. ETA Thu EOD.
Eva: I'll own alerts + dashboard (eviction_rate_10m -> infra-oncall). PR tomorrow.
Samir: I'll own rollback testing and a 5-step post-canary checklist for on-call. Testing in staging.
Lindsey: I'll draft fallback routing policy: when Dedicated queue growth >30% for 10m and eviction rate high, route to shared with soft throttle. Add config sample.
Tony: Candidate triage snippet:
```
# on-call quick checks
curl -s https://infra-metrics/api?m=evictions&window=15m | jq .value
kubectl -n inference get hpa -o wide | grep queue
# if evictions >50 and queue growth >20% -> escalate
```
Samir: Short rollback example: `redwood deploy rollback --service inference --to canary-2026-03-08` (staging-tested). Will add verification steps.
Eva: Proposing two alert tiers: `eviction_warning` (5m slack) and `eviction_critical` (10m page infra-oncall).
Mira: Also add an escalation matrix (on-call -> infra lead -> SRE manager) with paging windows 5/15/30. Keep each followup one line in the postmortem doc.
Eva: I'll add a recurrence detector metric that tags identical symptom clusters within 48h so we can avoid duplicate PMs.
sre-bot: Created JIRA INC-FUP-314 and will remind owners.
Mira: Final checklist (add to doc): 1) Runbook bullets (Tony) 2) Alerts + dashboard (Eva) 3) Rollback checklist (Samir) 4) Fallback policy + config (Lindsey) 5) Escalation matrix (Tony) 6) Recurrence detector (Eva). Due Thu EOD; verify Fri.
Tony: Will open PR and link it in the postmortem.
Samir: I'll split tasks into JIRA subtasks and link back.
Mira: Thanks — I'll sweep Friday and close out. :thumbsup:
